title: MIDI-REPA: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Symbolic Representation Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.20967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art text-to-music models increasingly rely on scaling model capacity, data, and compute, while still learning musical structure directly from dense audio. Yet melody, rhythm, harmony, and structure can be represented compactly in symbolic form. We introduce MIDI-REPA, a representation-alignment framework that derives MIDI supervision from automatic music transcription (AMT) to align intermediate representations of a flow-matching DiT. Building on the 122M-parameter FluxAudio-S baseline from the 2026 ICME Academic Text-To-Music Challenge, we investigate what, where, and when to align. Aligning a MuScriptor-derived piano roll with an early DiT layer throughout the full flow trajectory performs the best. Without additional training data or techniques, MIDI-REPA remains competitive on the ATTM objective metrics while remaining trainable on a single RTX 3090 in about 31 hours. Our results highlight symbolic supervision as a sim

translated_title: MIDI-REPA：通过符号表示对齐改进文本到音乐生成
translated_abstract: 最先进的文本到音乐模型日益依赖模型容量、数据和计算规模的扩展，同时仍然直接从密集音频中学习音乐结构。然而，旋律、节奏、和声与曲式结构可以以符号形式紧凑地表示。我们提出了MIDI-REPA，这是一个表示对齐框架，它从自动音乐转录（AMT）中获取MIDI监督信号，以对齐流匹配DiT的中间表示。基于2026年ICME学术文本到音乐挑战赛的122M参数FluxAudio-S基线模型，我们研究了对齐的内容、位置和时机。实验表明，将MuScriptor生成的钢琴卷帘表示与DiT早期层在整个流轨迹过程中进行对齐的效果最佳。在无需额外训练数据或技术的情况下，MIDI-REPA在ATTM客观指标上保持竞争力，同时可在单个RTX 3090上于约31小时内完成训练。我们的结果凸显了符号监督作为一种简单而有效的提升音乐生成模型性能的方式。
tldr: MIDI-REPA通过自动音乐转录提取MIDI符号监督信号，并将其与流匹配DiT早期层的中间表示进行对齐，从而在无需额外数据且仅用单张RTX 3090训练约31小时的低成本条件下，显著提升文本到音乐生成的音乐结构质量。
en_tdlr: MIDI-REPA aligns MIDI symbolic supervision derived from automatic music transcription with intermediate representations of a flow-matching DiT, enabling competitive text-to-music generation without extra data while being trainable on a single RTX 3090 in about 31 hours.
